title: City of Laredo Honors Air Force Sergeant, Champion Student Teams and Community Volunteers
excerpt: The City of Laredo recognized a group of community honorees during Monday's City Council meeting, including U.S. Air Force Staff Sergeant Juan Enrique Reyna II, undefeated student volleyball and flag football teams, the Seven Flags Foundation, and a volunteer who has led the Border Flag Football League for 25 years.
content:
The City of Laredo honored a group of local standouts during Monday night's City Council meeting, recognizing their service, championships, and years of volunteer work in the community.

Staff Sergeant Juan Enrique Reyna II, E-5, of the United States Air Force, was recognized for his distinguished service to the nation and his dedication to protecting the country's freedoms.

On the sports side, the city honored the United South Middle School Lady Leopards Black Volleyball Team for an undefeated sixth-grade season and the 2026 2A Gold Division Championship; the Elias Herrera Middle School Hawks sixth-grade flag football team for winning the 2026 Boys & Girls Club of Laredo City Championship, Gold Bracket; and the San Isidro Elementary Raptors flag football team for three consecutive undefeated championships.

The Seven Flags Foundation Leadership was honored for its charitable work, including toy donations, meal packages, and community outreach for local families, children, and seniors. Arturo Santos Jr. was recognized for 25 years of volunteer service as president of the Border Flag Football League, creating opportunities for hundreds of Laredo residents to play sports and stay active.

Each of these recognitions reflects the talent, generosity, perseverance, and community spirit that make Laredo special, the city said.

Source: City of Laredo, Nov. 16, 2026.
